description: Baseline animation benchmark currently scores 0 and repository checks fail before any motion work. asi={"hypothesis":"Measure current motion-polish coverage before implementing animation primitives.","rollback_reason":"Baseline run failed repository checks, so no code change can be kept yet.","next_action_hint":"Inspect lint/test failures, then implement spec-aligned animation primitives plus a durable benchmark."}

Add spec-aligned animation primitives: route/page transition wrapper, staggered dashboard reveals, toast entrance motion, animated mobile nav panel, and required lint cleanup. asi={"hypothesis":"Implement a small set of restrained motion primitives from UX_UI_SPEC so animation coverage improves without adding flashy or benchmark-only effects.","implemented":["PageTransition wrapper around protected routes","toast-enter animation for toasts","menu-panel mobile nav open/close transition","stagger-group/stagger-item utilities on dashboard cards and checklist"],"guardrails":["kept reduced-motion global override intact","limited motion to subtle fade/translate/scale tokens","paired benchmark with lint+test so score reflects shippable UI changes"]}

Expanded animation workload baseline: current implementation covers protected-route transitions, toast/menu motion, and dashboard stagger, but public-route continuity plus broader page sequencing are still missing. asi={"hypothesis":"Re-benchmark animation coverage with a broader, less gameable workload spanning public routes and multiple pages.","rollback_reason":"Baseline only; no product change to keep.","next_action_hint":"Add public-route transitions and lightweight stagger sequencing to home, login, and list pages without increasing motion intensity.","gap_summary":["public login/reset/not-found routes lack PageTransition coverage","home page and login page lack staggered sequencing","list pages do not consistently apply restrained stagger patterns"]}

Expand restrained motion coverage to public routes and additional pages: PageTransition now wraps login/reset/not-found, plus stagger sequencing on home, login highlights, books grids, and meetings lists. asi={"hypothesis":"Broader but still subtle animation sequencing across public routes and key list pages should improve real motion coverage without overfitting to a single screen.","implemented":["PageTransition on login/reset-password/not-found routes","stagger sequencing on home hero and summary cards","staggered login highlight list","staggered books grid and meetings survey/upcoming lists","benchmark expanded to multi-page workload"],"guardrails":["kept animation primitives limited to fade/translate only","used low 20ms stagger step per UX spec","retained reduced-motion fallback through global override"],"learned":"The previous benchmark saturated too quickly; expanding it across public and list pages made the workload less gameable and more representative."}

Collection-pages animation baseline: public/protected transitions and several staggered pages are covered, but at least one remaining collection page still lacks the sequencing pattern under the broader workload. asi={"hypothesis":"Broaden the animation workload again so collection pages, not just hero screens, influence the score.","rollback_reason":"Baseline only; no new product change yet.","next_action_hint":"Add restrained stagger sequencing to the remaining collection page(s), then update the benchmark script to match the broader workload.","gap_summary":["one or more of surveys/wishlist still lack stagger-group plus indexed items","collection-page coverage should be consistent before stopping"]}

Complete restrained stagger coverage across collection pages by adding the sequencing pattern to surveys and wishlist, and align the benchmark with that broader workload. asi={"hypothesis":"Consistent page-entry sequencing across all collection pages will improve animation quality more honestly than stacking extra effects onto already-polished screens.","implemented":["staggered survey card lists for admin and member views","staggered wishlist suggestion grid","benchmark now scores surveys and wishlist coverage explicitly"],"guardrails":["left dense forms largely quiet","kept motion limited to existing fade-rise primitives","avoided adding decorative loops or long-duration transitions"],"learned":"The remaining animation gap was breadth, not intensity—coverage improvements across list pages raised the score cleanly without changing the motion language."}

Detail/admin workload baseline: collection-page motion coverage is now broad, but stats and meeting-detail pages still lack the same staggered entry treatment under the expanded workload. asi={"hypothesis":"Test whether animation coverage still has obvious gaps on denser detail/admin screens once collection pages are handled.","rollback_reason":"Baseline only; no new product change yet.","next_action_hint":"Add subtle stagger sequencing to stats summaries and meeting-detail metadata/attendee sections, keeping forms mostly quiet.","gap_summary":["stats page lacks stagger-group sequencing","meeting-detail page lacks staggered metadata/list reveal"]}
